item.title: Dublin: Single-family residence sells for $1 million
item.description: A house in the 7500 block of Honey Court in Dublin has new owners. The 1,116-square-foot property, built in 1960, was sold on Dec. 5, 2025 for $1,032,000 which works out to $925 per square foot. This single-story house has three bedrooms and two baths. The unit encompasses a generous 7,788 square feet of land.

item.title: Woman who rented a dozen “MarryLisa.com” billboards on Highway 101 has a Valentine!
item.description: The viral story of this 42-year-old woman advertising for a husband on the side of the tech industry’s major commuter route tapped into the frustrations and heartbreak of many Silicon Valley singles yearning for love but coming up empty on the dating apps.

item.title: Condominium sells for $1.6 million in Dublin
item.description: A 2,297-square-foot condominium built in 2021 has changed hands. The spacious new property in the 5600 block of Lexington Avenue in Dublin was sold on Dec. 9, 2025 for $1,558,000, or $678 per square foot. This condo provides a generous living space with its four bedrooms and two bathrooms. Additionally, the condo is equipped with two parking spots, granting ample parking space for two vehicles.

item.title: U.S. Rep. Ro Khanna walks back four of six names he concedes are not linked to Epstein
item.description: The error occurred after Khanna and U.S. Rep. Thomas Massie, authors of the bipartisan Epstein Transparency Act passed last fall, were allowed to view numerous documents made available Monday by the Justice Department.

item.title: ‘It’s our game’: San Ramon Valley’s runaway train fast-break offense powers Wolves to 4th straight EBAL title
item.description: San Ramon Valley's team of wild horses poured on the fast-break points as the Wolves further established themselves as the team to beat in the East Bay heading into the NCS playoffs.
